Subject: EMEA + APAC theatre: forecast synchronization & pipeline hygiene

Team — quick alignment for the week: finance needs a clean snapshot for our Q2 board pack and APAC leadership has asked for committed coverage by EOD Friday. Can everyone do a run of stage hygiene against open opportunities and confirm commitments where appropriate?

What I need by EOD Fri: 
- A single-row update per deal in column format: current stage, most recent activity, probability, ACV, and close date
- Any deals you expect to move to Commit must include one-line rationale and next milestone (call, PO, legal, etc.)
- If you're expecting pricing/procurement delays, flag them and add expected resolution dates

I've attached a combined snapshot template (EMEA_pipeline_snapshot_Q2.xlsx) — please paste a single summary row per deal and upload the tracker to the shared Drive link.

Thanks — small, measurable updates please.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, EMEA Field Sales
Redwood Inference
